rules.install:
for ENTRY in magic python3; do install -d -m 0755 "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$ENTRY" done
FULL_INSTALL="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/magic"
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" make DESTDIR="$FULL_INSTALL" install
install -d -m 0755 "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/file" install -d -m 0755 "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/share/file"
ln -sf ../../share/misc/magic.mgc "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/file/magic.mgc" ln -sf ../../share/misc/magic.mgc "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/share/file/magic.mgc"
cd python bh_python_install --py3 --root "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/python3"
